baselines.handoff: Plain HANDOFF when offered;forced sole action preserved

prediction_scope: One-step choices on recorded reached states with exact original actions. No world execution,model calls,oracle choice or retrospective winner selection. This cannot substitute for Host rollouts.
score_scope: Existing positive-preference labels;an unaccepted choice is not proof of an illegal or useless operation. Masked states remain unknown.
position_scope: Actual canonical-order native evaluation wire;reviewed original-source whole-body/range coverage,not minimal fact spans,source truth or Host delivery. Partial witnesses remain partial.
missing_and_ambiguous_identity: Report explicitly;do not invent source matches or minimal support spans.
